"""Summarize only NEW134 returned metadata and complete training-curve UTF8.

No model, physical trajectory raw, NPZ, SDK, GPU, or SSH is opened here.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, math, time

N = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
T = N.parent
L = T / 'MOD4_H1_OVERNIGHT_FUDAN_SUPERMIMIC_REPAIR_GOAL_20261027'
Q = L / 'TWO134_FUDAN133_LINE_Z_FIRST_CLOSING_INITIAL_CPU_SOURCE_V1'
R = N / 'reports'

def read(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_bytes())

def put(name, value):
    with (R / name).open('xb') as out:
        out.write((json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode('utf8'))

def aggregate(rows, names):
    if not rows:
        return dict(rows=0, status='NO_EXPOSURE_NOT_ZERO_SCORE')
    result = dict(rows=len(rows), first_completed_control=rows[0]['completed_control_rows'],
        last_completed_control=rows[-1]['completed_control_rows'],
        total_reward_mean=sum(x['fudan_real_reward_tracking']['components']['total'] for x in rows) / len(rows),
        selected_terms={})
    for name in names:
        vals = [x['fudan_real_reward_tracking']['components']['selected_optimization_terms'][name] for x in rows]
        result['selected_terms'][name] = dict(mean=sum(vals)/len(vals), minimum=min(vals), maximum=max(vals),
            nonzero_rows=sum(v != 0 for v in vals))
    return result

def main():
    v = read(Q / 'reports/TWO134_COMPLETE_FINALS_OR_PARTIALS_ORIGINAL_COST_RETURNED_V2_ACTUAL.json')
    qualified = read(Q / 'reports/TWO134_INITIAL_TWO_FORMAL_CPU_QUALIFIED_ACTUAL.json')
    assert qualified['passed'] and qualified['NEW_formal_loads'] == 2 and qualified['shared_normal86_loads'] == 1
    assert qualified['input_native131_loads'] == 0
    assert v['actual_one72_finite_returned'] and v['all_two_original_owner_nodes_workers_out']
    assert v['canonical_None'] and v['original_private_shared_writer_locks_free']
    assert set(v['published']) == {'h1', 'h1_seed28'}
    assert v['unique_original_segment']['charged_expert_seconds'] == v['original_fee_seconds'] == sum(v['original_fee_by_slot'].values())
    rows, curves = {}, {}
    for key, pub in v['published'].items():
        p = pub['original_producer']
        w = p['native88_migration_window']['counters']
        event = p['original_H1_events']['original270_completed_control_events']
        assert event['diagnostic_valid'] and event['invalid_rows'] == 0 and not event['diagnostic_write_errors']
        assert pub['twohost_complete_SHA'] and pub['NEW_formal_transfer_count'] == 1
        rows[key] = dict(model=pub, native_iteration=w['native_iteration'], WM=w['world_updates'], Pi=w['policy_updates'],
            window=w, physical_events=event)
        names = p['producer']['fudan_step_task']['command_reward116']['selected_optimization_term_names']
        assert len(names) == 13 and len(set(names)) == 13
        matches = [x for x in v['all_original_texts_full_case_safe']
            if x['relative'].endswith('/ACTUAL_H1_CONVERGENCE_CURVE.jsonl')
            and x['relative'].startswith('h1_slot/' if key == 'h1' else 'seed28_slot/')]
        assert len(matches) == 1
        ref = matches[0]
        path = Path(ref['local_path'])
        before = path.stat()
        data = path.read_bytes()
        assert len(data) == ref['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == ref['SHA']
        assert path.stat().st_mtime_ns == before.st_mtime_ns
        all_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in data.decode('utf8').splitlines() if line.strip()]
        actual, unmeasured = [], []
        max_error = 0.0
        for x in all_rows:
            c = x['fudan_real_reward_tracking']['components']
            if c is None:
                unmeasured.append(x['completed_control_rows'])
                continue
            assert set(c['selected_optimization_terms']) == set(names)
            values = [c['selected_optimization_terms'][name] for name in names]
            assert all(math.isfinite(t) for t in values) and math.isfinite(c['total'])
            max_error = max(max_error, abs(sum(values) - c['total']))
            actual.append(x)
        assert max_error <= 1e-7
        requested = [x for x in actual if x['fudan_real_reward_tracking']['components']['contact_step_modes']['command_forward_velocity'] > .45]
        curves[key] = dict(producer=ref, total_curve_rows=len(all_rows), unmeasured_metadata_rows=len(unmeasured),
            unmeasured_completed_controls=unmeasured, measured_rows=len(actual),
            first_request_and_last100=dict(first100=aggregate(requested[:100], names), last100=aggregate(requested[-100:], names)),
            whole_request_rows=aggregate(requested, names), selected_sum_error_max=max_error,
            last_curve_control=all_rows[-1]['completed_control_rows'], formal_controls=w['completed_fresh_controls'],
            last_measured_request_command=actual[-1]['fudan_real_reward_tracking']['components']['contact_step_modes']['command_forward_velocity'])
    zero = all(x['physical_events']['both_leading_edges_cross_event_count'] == 0
        and x['physical_events']['events']['landing_count'] == 0
        and x['physical_events']['events']['recovery_count'] == 0 for x in rows.values())
    closed = dict(epoch=time.time(), run_id=v['cohort']['run_id'] if 'run_id' in v['cohort'] else read(R/'CURRENT_ACTUAL134_TWO_POSITIVE_HEIGHT_GRADIENT_FIRST_NEW_WM_PI_WORK_ORDER.json')['run_id'],
        actual_closed=True, actual_initial_two_formal_CPU_passed=True,
        NEW_formal_loads=2, shared_normal86_loads=1, input131_loads=0, rows=rows,
        fees=v['original_fee_by_slot'], fee_sum_once=v['original_fee_seconds'],
        closing_snapshot_not_live=v['closing_remaining_snapshot'], actual_CNone=True, all_own_wait_out=True,
        private_shared_locks_free=True, complete_original_UTF8_count=len(v['all_original_texts_full_case_safe']),
        fulltext_bytes=v['text_bytes'], both_cross_landing_recovery_zero=zero,
        contact_release_takeoff_not_5mm_or_27cm=True, latest_qualified_METHOD134=True,
        skill_achieved=False, skill_scope='No skill graduation is inferred from fullstate qualification, dense reward or update counts; original270 physical evidence must be assessed separately.',
        no_new_frozen_case_MuJoCo_or_extra_checkpoint_read=True,
        no_binary_model_physics_raw_or_GPU_read_by_this_summary=True)
    curve = dict(epoch=time.time(), purpose='Closed134 complete UTF8 training-curve component review; zero model, physical trajectory raw, SDK, GPU or SSH reads',
        rows=curves, selection='Population contact_step_modes.command_forward_velocity > .45, not individual episode age, full command-instance completion or every environment.',
        not_whole_episode_return_or_jump_probability_or_causal_proof=True,
        curve_last_may_precede_formal_control=True, initial_null_components_preserved_as_unmeasured=True,
        all13_selected_terms_checked=True, no_model_binary_or_actual_physics_raw_read=True)
    put('CLOSED134_FUDAN133_SELECTED_TERMS_FULL_CURVES_REQUEST_SCOPE_TEXT_ONLY_ACTUAL.json', curve)
    put('CURRENT_CLOSED134_TWO_QUALIFIED_FUDAN133_FORMALS_ACTUAL.json', closed)
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True, qualified_METHOD134=True,
        rows={k:dict(SHA=x['model']['SHA'], bytes=x['model']['bytes'], WM=x['WM'], Pi=x['Pi'],
            newWM=x['window']['new_world_updates'], newPi=x['window']['new_policy_updates'], controls=x['window']['completed_fresh_controls'],
            events=x['physical_events']['events'], cross=x['physical_events']['both_leading_edges_cross_event_count']) for k,x in rows.items()},
        fees=closed['fees'], fee_sum_once=closed['fee_sum_once'], closing_snapshot=closed['closing_snapshot_not_live'],
        fulltext_count=closed['complete_original_UTF8_count'], fulltext_bytes=closed['fulltext_bytes'],
        curve_rows={k:x['total_curve_rows'] for k,x in curves.items()},
        request_rows={k:x['whole_request_rows']['rows'] for k,x in curves.items()},
        source_only_gradient_not_physical_jump_proof=True, skill_not_inferred=True)))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except BaseException:
        import traceback
        put('CLOSED134_TEXT_SUMMARY_ORIGINAL_ERROR_' + str(time.time_ns()) + '.json', dict(error=traceback.format_exc(),
            original_reports_unchanged=True, no_model_or_physics_raw_read=True))
        raise

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def method_node(tree, cls, name):
    c = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == cls)
    return next(n for n in c.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)


def method_ast_hash(n):
    return sha(ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False).encode('utf-8'))


def inspect_installed_method_files(joint_file, wrapper_file):
    """Parse genuinely selected installation files in future0PT target admission.

    No import/execution of these SDK modules is performed by this function.
    Paths are supplied from actual find_spec roots, not historical fixture paths.
    """
    result = {}
    for group, path in [('joint', Path(joint_file)), ('wrapper', Path(wrapper_file))]:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        tree = ast.parse(raw)
        rows = []
        for cls, name in METHODS[group]:
            fn = method_node(tree, cls, name)
            rows.append(dict(class_name=cls, method=name, AST_SHA=method_ast_hash(fn),
                             line=fn.lineno, end_line=fn.end_lineno,
                             exact_source=ast.get_source_segment(raw.decode('utf-8'), fn)))
        result[group] = dict(path=str(path.resolve()), bytes=len(raw), SHA=sha(raw), methods=rows)
    joint_tree = ast.parse(Path(joint_file).read_bytes())
    base = method_node(joint_tree, 'JointAction', 'process_actions')
    # Source-specific diagnostic admission; retain the actual entire method hash.
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and ast.unparse(n) ==
               'self._processed_actions = self._raw_actions * self._scale + self._offset'
               for n in base.body), 'Actual affine source differs; no historical API assumption'
    position = method_node(joint_tree, 'JointPositionAction', 'apply_actions')
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute)
               and n.func.attr == 'set_joint_position_target_index' for n in ast.walk(position))
    wrapper = method_node(ast.parse(Path(wrapper_file).read_bytes()), 'RslRlVecEnvWrapper', 'step')
    env_calls = [n for n in ast.walk(wrapper) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'self.env.step']
    assert len(env_calls) == 1
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'torch.clamp' for n in ast.walk(wrapper))
    return dict(passed=True, scope='Actual installation source bytes/AST only; NOT App/model/CUDA proof',
                actual_installed_method_files=result, no_historical_source_substitution=True,
                no_SDK_module_execution_or_PT_NPZ_GPU_RNG=True)

            self.terms = {key: e.action_manager.get_term(key) for key in ('legs', 'wheels')}
            self.term_ids = {id(v): k for k, v in self.terms.items()}
            self.bind_runtime_methods()
            self.install()
            self.emit('ACTUAL_CACHED_TERM_CONFIGURATION_AND_ORIGINAL_LIMITS',
                term_configuration={k: dict(joint_ids=term._joint_ids, joint_names=term._joint_names,
                    scale=term._scale, offset=term._offset, cfg_clip=term.cfg.clip,
                    optional_clip_buffer=getattr(term, '_clip', None)) for k, term in self.terms.items()},
                actual_joint_names=list(e.scene['robot'].joint_names),
                existing_full30_limits=query_observer.full30_limits,
                existing_default_joint_pos=self.cached(e.scene['robot'].data.default_joint_pos),
                selected_only_26_IDs=True, no_added_original_getter=True)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('constructor_or_actual_runtime_method_binding', traceback.format_exc())
            self.uninstall()

    def cached(self, value):
        return value.torch if hasattr(value, 'torch') else value

    def invalid(self, where, error):
        if len(self.errors) < 32:
            self.errors.append(dict(where=where, error=error))

    def snapshot(self, value):
        t = self.t
        value = self.cached(value)
        if t.is_tensor(value):
            original_shape = list(value.shape)
            per_env = value.ndim > 0 and value.shape[0] == self.e.num_envs
            v = value.index_select(0, self.ids.to(device=value.device, dtype=t.long)) if per_env else value
            v = v.detach().cpu()
            row = dict(dtype=str(v.dtype), original_device=str(value.device), shape=list(v.shape),
                       original_shape=original_shape, axis0_is_selected_env=per_env)
            if v.is_floating_point() and not bool(t.isfinite(v).all()):
                finite = t.isfinite(v)
                if bool(t.isnan(v).any()):
                    self.invalid('NaN_diagnostic_value', 'NaN retained with explicit code2; original value/result not changed')
                codes = t.where(t.isposinf(v), t.ones_like(v, dtype=t.int8),
                        t.where(t.isneginf(v), -t.ones_like(v, dtype=t.int8),
                        t.where(t.isnan(v), t.full_like(v, 2, dtype=t.int8), t.zeros_like(v, dtype=t.int8))))
                row.update(finite_value_or_zero=t.where(finite, v, t.zeros_like(v)).tolist(), nonfinite_code=codes.tolist(),
                           nonfinite_code_semantics={'0': 'finite value', '1': '+infinity', '-1': '-infinity', '2': 'NaN; diagnostic domain invalid'})
            else:
                row['value'] = v.tolist()
            return row
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            if all(isinstance(k, str) for k in value):
                return {k: self.snapshot(v) for k, v in value.items()}
            return dict(container_type='typed_key_mapping', entries=[dict(key=encode_snapshot_mapping_key(k),
                          value=self.snapshot(v)) for k, v in value.items()])
        if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
            return [self.snapshot(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, slice):
            return dict(container_type='slice', start=value.start, stop=value.stop, step=value.step)
        if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
            return dict(scalar_type='float', nonfinite='+infinity' if value > 0 else '-infinity' if value < 0 else 'NaN')
        if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, bool, int, float)):
            return value
        raise TypeError('Unsupported typed join value: ' + type(value).__name__)

    def keys(self):
        return dict(env_id=self.ids, sensor_episode=self.e._sensor_mild.episode,
                    original_recipe=self.e.recovery.recipe, control_seq=self.control,
                    original_issue_physics_tick=self.issue_tick, callback_tick=int(self.e._sim_step_counter),
                    queue_episode_by_group={k: self.e._physics_action_delay.queue.groups[k]['episode'] for k in self.terms})

    def emit(self, event, **values):
        try:
            if self.rows >= 1200:
                self.limited = True
                self.invalid('retention_cap', '1200 selected rows exceeded')
                return
            row = dict(kind='E3_same_UID_single_actor_process_delay_join_v10', event=event,
                       keys=self.snapshot(self.keys()), values=self.snapshot(values))
            raw = (json.dumps(row, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
            if self.byte_count + len(raw) > 16 * 1024**2:
                self.limited = True
                self.invalid('retention_cap', '16MiB typed selected JSONL cap exceeded')
                return
            assert self.stream is not None and not self.stream.closed
            assert self.stream.write(raw) == len(raw)
            self.digest.update(raw)
            self.byte_count += len(raw)
            self.rows += 1
            self.counts[event] += 1
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('tap:' + event, traceback.format_exc())

    def bind_runtime_methods(self):
        assert self.proof['passed'] and self.proof['no_historical_source_substitution']
        self.base = next(c for c in type(self.terms['legs']).__mro__ if c.__name__ == 'JointAction')
        assert self.base in type(self.terms['wheels']).__mro__
        for group, cls, method in [('joint', self.base, 'process_actions'), ('wrapper', type(self.vec), 'step')]:
            fn = getattr(cls, method)
            p = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(fn)).resolve()
            expected = self.proof['actual_installed_method_files'][group]
            raw = p.read_bytes()
            assert str(p) == expected['path'] and len(raw) == expected['bytes'] and sha(raw) == expected['SHA']
            src = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(fn)))
            n = next(n for n in src.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef))
            row = next(r for r in expected['methods'] if r['class_name'] == cls.__name__ and r['method'] == method)
            assert method_ast_hash(n) == row['AST_SHA']
        self.metadata_bound = True

    def replace(self, obj, name, value):
        old = getattr(obj, name)
        self.undo.append((obj, name, old))
        setattr(obj, name, value)
        return old

    def original(self, label, call, args, kwargs):
        try:
            return call(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('original_exception:' + label, traceback.format_exc())
            raise

    def actor_return(self, control_index, action):
        try:
            self.control = int(control_index) + 1
            self.issue_tick = int(self.e._sim_step_counter)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('actor_context', traceback.format_exc())
        self.emit('ORIGINAL_SINGLE_ACTOR_RETURN', action=action)

    def install(self):
        join = self
        original_vec = self.vec.step
        def vec_step(this, *args, **kwargs):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_WRAPPER_STEP_INPUT_BEFORE_CLIP', action=args[0] if args else kwargs['actions'])
            return join.original('vec.step', original_vec, args, kwargs)
        self.replace(self.vec, 'step', types.MethodType(vec_step, self.vec))
        original_real = self.e.step
        def real_step(this, *args, **kwargs):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_REAL_STEP_INPUT_AFTER_WRAPPER_CLIP', action=args[0] if args else kwargs['action'])
            return join.original('real.step', original_real, args, kwargs)
        self.replace(self.e, 'step', types.MethodType(real_step, self.e))
        original_affine = self.base.process_actions
        def affine(this, *args, **kwargs):
            result = join.original('SDK.JointAction.process_actions', original_affine, (this,) + args, kwargs)
            if id(this) in join.term_ids:
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_AFFINE_OPTIONAL_CLIP_OUTPUT_BEFORE_CAD', group=join.term_ids[id(this)],
                          raw_actions=this.raw_actions, processed_actions=this.processed_actions)
            return result
        self.replace(self.base, 'process_actions', affine)
        for key, term in self.terms.items():
            old = term.process_actions
            def process(this, *args, _key=key, _old=old, **kwargs):
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_INPUT', group=_key, action=args[0] if args else kwargs['actions'])
                result = join.original('term.process:' + _key, _old, args, kwargs)
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_OUTPUT_AFTER_CAD_AND_SUBMIT', group=_key,
                          raw_actions=this.raw_actions, processed_actions=this.processed_actions)
                return result
            self.replace(term, 'process_actions', types.MethodType(process, term))
        queue = self.e._physics_action_delay.queue
        original_submit = queue.submit
        def submit(key, x, tick):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_INPUT_AFTER_CAD', group=key, issue_tick=int(tick), target=x)
            result = join.original('queue.submit:' + key, original_submit, (key, x, tick), {})
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_SCHEDULE', group=key, original_queue_state=queue.groups[key])
            return result
        self.replace(queue, 'submit', submit)
        original_apply = queue.apply
        def apply(key, tick):
            result = join.original('queue.apply:' + key, original_apply, (key, tick), {})
            if int(tick) < 40:
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_APPLY_RETURN', group=key, apply_tick=int(tick), target=result,
                          original_queue_state=queue.groups[key])
            return result
        self.replace(queue, 'apply', apply)
        original_safe = self.q.safe
        def retained_query(event, **values):
            result = join.original('existing_query.safe', original_safe, (event,), values)
            if event == 'AFTER_ORIGINAL_PHYSICS_SCENE_UPDATE':
                join.emit('EXISTING_CALLBACK_PD_TARGET_AND_DOF_READBACK', existing_values=values,
                          no_added_body_DOF_limit_or_closure_query=True)
            return result
        self.replace(self.q, 'safe', retained_query)
        self.installed = True

    def uninstall(self):
        for obj, name, old in reversed(self.undo):
            try:
                setattr(obj, name, old)
            except BaseException:
                self.invalid('restore_original_attribute:' + name, traceback.format_exc())
        self.undo = []

    def finish(self):
        self.uninstall()
        try:
            if self.stream is not None:
                self.stream.flush()
                self.stream.close()
            self.closed = True
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('close_stream', traceback.format_exc())
        expected = {'ORIGINAL_SINGLE_ACTOR_RETURN': 24, 'ORIGINAL_WRAPPER_STEP_INPUT_BEFORE_CLIP': 24,
                    'ORIGINAL_REAL_STEP_INPUT_AFTER_WRAPPER_CLIP': 24,

                    'ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_INPUT_AFTER_CAD': 48, 'ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_SCHEDULE': 48,
                    'ORIGINAL_DELAY_APPLY_RETURN': 80, 'EXISTING_CALLBACK_PD_TARGET_AND_DOF_READBACK': 40}
        try:
            if any(self.counts[k] != n for k, n in expected.items()):
                self.invalid('coverage', 'Actual tap counts differ from original24 controls / both40callbacks: ' + str(dict(self.counts)))
            path = self.out / STREAM

            if not complete:

            value = dict(kind='E3_single_actor_process_delay_same_UID_join_v10',
                diagnostic_valid=self.installed and self.metadata_bound and not self.errors and not self.limited and complete,
                status='INVALID' if self.errors or self.limited or not complete else 'COMPLETE_RETAINED_JOIN_ONLY',
                errors=self.errors, retention_limited=self.limited, actual_counts=dict(self.counts), required_counts=expected,
                actual_installed_method_bytes_AST_bound=self.metadata_bound,
                producer=dict(path=str(path), relative='action_join/' + STREAM, bytes=size,
                    SHA=self.digest.hexdigest() if complete else None, rows=self.rows,
                    type='selected_same_UID_episode_issue_callback_typed_JSONL', full_file_closed=complete,
                    SHA_is_streaming_producer_not_extra_file_read=True, default_transfer='metadata_only'),

                    original_simulation_seconds=.48, physics_ticks_retained=40,

class InvalidJoin:
    def __init__(self, out, error):
        self.out = Path(out)
        self.error = error
    def actor_return(self, control_index, action):
        return None
    def finish(self):
        value = dict(kind='E3_single_actor_process_delay_same_UID_join_v10', diagnostic_valid=False,
            status='INVALID', errors=[dict(where='constructor_before_hook_installation', error=self.error)],
            original_methods_not_called_retried_or_modified=True, physical24_must_be_read_separately=True,
            producer=None, skill_graduation=False, complete_WM_dataset=False)
        try:
            self.out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            with (self.out / JOIN_PROOF).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        except BaseException:
            value['publication_error'] = traceback.format_exc()
        return value


def install_join(e, vec, observer, torch, out, proof):
    # Even pre-install diagnostic constructor failures do not alter the original
    # actor/step path. A failed tap never retries any original function.
    try:
        return SingleActorActionJoin(e, vec, observer, torch, out, proof)
    except BaseException:
        return InvalidJoin(out, traceback.format_exc())

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def method_node(tree, cls, name):
    c = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == cls)
    return next(n for n in c.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)


def method_ast_hash(n):
    return sha(ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False).encode('utf-8'))


def inspect_installed_method_files(joint_file, wrapper_file):
    """Parse genuinely selected installation files in future0PT target admission.

    No import/execution of these SDK modules is performed by this function.
    Paths are supplied from actual find_spec roots, not historical fixture paths.
    """
    result = {}
    for group, path in [('joint', Path(joint_file)), ('wrapper', Path(wrapper_file))]:
        raw = path.read_bytes()

        rows = []
        for cls, name in METHODS[group]:
            fn = method_node(tree, cls, name)
            rows.append(dict(class_name=cls, method=name, AST_SHA=method_ast_hash(fn),
                             line=fn.lineno, end_line=fn.end_lineno,
                             exact_source=ast.get_source_segment(raw.decode('utf-8'), fn)))
        result[group] = dict(path=str(path.resolve()), bytes=len(raw), SHA=sha(raw), methods=rows)
    joint_tree = ast.parse(Path(joint_file).read_bytes())

    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute)
               and n.func.attr == 'set_joint_position_target_index' for n in ast.walk(position))
    wrapper = method_node(ast.parse(Path(wrapper_file).read_bytes()), 'RslRlVecEnvWrapper', 'step')
    env_calls = [n for n in ast.walk(wrapper) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'self.env.step']
    assert len(env_calls) == 1
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'torch.clamp' for n in ast.walk(wrapper))
    return dict(passed=True, scope='Actual installation source bytes/AST only; NOT App/model/CUDA proof',
                actual_installed_method_files=result, no_historical_source_substitution=True,
                no_SDK_module_execution_or_PT_NPZ_GPU_RNG=True)


def collect_actual_target_method_metadata(job):
    lab = Path(importlib.util.find_spec('isaaclab').origin).resolve().parent
    rl = Path(importlib.util.find_spec('isaaclab_rl').origin).resolve().parent
    value = inspect_installed_method_files(lab / 'envs/mdp/actions/joint_actions.py',
                                           rl / 'rsl_rl/vecenv_wrapper.py')
    value['actual_package_roots'] = dict(isaaclab=str(lab), isaaclab_rl=str(rl))
    with (Path(job) / METHOD_PROOF).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    return value


class SingleActorActionJoin:
    def __init__(self, e, vec, query_observer, torch, out, method_proof):
        self.e = e
        self.vec = vec
        self.q = query_observer
        self.t = torch
        self.out = Path(out)
        self.ids = query_observer.ids.detach().clone()
        self.errors = []
        self.counts = Counter()
        self.undo = []
        self.control = None
        self.issue_tick = None
        self.byte_count = 0
        self.rows = 0
        self.digest = hashlib.sha256()
        self.stream = None
        self.limited = False
        self.installed = False
        self.closed = False
        self.metadata_bound = False
        self.term_ids = {}
        self.terms = {}
        self.proof = method_proof
        try:
            self.out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
            self.stream = (self.out / STREAM).open('xb')
            assert e.num_envs == 20000 and e.physics_dt == .0025 and e.step_dt == .02
            assert len(self.ids) == 26 and query_observer.full30_limits is not None
            self.terms = {key: e.action_manager.get_term(key) for key in ('legs', 'wheels')}
            self.term_ids = {id(v): k for k, v in self.terms.items()}
            self.bind_runtime_methods()
            self.install()
            self.emit('ACTUAL_CACHED_TERM_CONFIGURATION_AND_ORIGINAL_LIMITS',
                term_configuration={k: dict(joint_ids=term._joint_ids, joint_names=term._joint_names,
                    scale=term._scale, offset=term._offset, cfg_clip=term.cfg.clip,
                    optional_clip_buffer=getattr(term, '_clip', None)) for k, term in self.terms.items()},
                actual_joint_names=list(e.scene['robot'].joint_names),
                existing_full30_limits=query_observer.full30_limits,
                existing_default_joint_pos=self.cached(e.scene['robot'].data.default_joint_pos),
                selected_only_26_IDs=True, no_added_original_getter=True)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('constructor_or_actual_runtime_method_binding', traceback.format_exc())
            self.uninstall()

    def cached(self, value):
        return value.torch if hasattr(value, 'torch') else value

    def invalid(self, where, error):
        if len(self.errors) < 32:
            self.errors.append(dict(where=where, error=error))

    def snapshot(self, value):
        t = self.t
        value = self.cached(value)
        if t.is_tensor(value):
            original_shape = list(value.shape)
            per_env = value.ndim > 0 and value.shape[0] == self.e.num_envs
            v = value.index_select(0, self.ids.to(device=value.device, dtype=t.long)) if per_env else value
            v = v.detach().cpu()
            row = dict(dtype=str(v.dtype), original_device=str(value.device), shape=list(v.shape),
                       original_shape=original_shape, axis0_is_selected_env=per_env)
            if v.is_floating_point() and not bool(t.isfinite(v).all()):
                finite = t.isfinite(v)
                if bool(t.isnan(v).any()):
                    self.invalid('NaN_diagnostic_value', 'NaN retained with explicit code2; original value/result not changed')
                codes = t.where(t.isposinf(v), t.ones_like(v, dtype=t.int8),
                        t.where(t.isneginf(v), -t.ones_like(v, dtype=t.int8),
                        t.where(t.isnan(v), t.full_like(v, 2, dtype=t.int8), t.zeros_like(v, dtype=t.int8))))
                row.update(finite_value_or_zero=t.where(finite, v, t.zeros_like(v)).tolist(), nonfinite_code=codes.tolist(),
                           nonfinite_code_semantics={'0': 'finite value', '1': '+infinity', '-1': '-infinity', '2': 'NaN; diagnostic domain invalid'})
            else:
                row['value'] = v.tolist()
            return row
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            if all(isinstance(k, str) for k in value):
                return {k: self.snapshot(v) for k, v in value.items()}
            return dict(container_type='typed_key_mapping', entries=[dict(key=encode_snapshot_mapping_key(k),
                          value=self.snapshot(v)) for k, v in value.items()])
        if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
            return [self.snapshot(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, slice):
            return dict(container_type='slice', start=value.start, stop=value.stop, step=value.step)
        if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
            return dict(scalar_type='float', nonfinite='+infinity' if value > 0 else '-infinity' if value < 0 else 'NaN')
        if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, bool, int, float)):
            return value
        raise TypeError('Unsupported typed join value: ' + type(value).__name__)

    def keys(self):
        return dict(env_id=self.ids, sensor_episode=self.e._sensor_mild.episode,
                    original_recipe=self.e.recovery.recipe, control_seq=self.control,
                    original_issue_physics_tick=self.issue_tick, callback_tick=int(self.e._sim_step_counter),
                    queue_episode_by_group={k: self.e._physics_action_delay.queue.groups[k]['episode'] for k in self.terms})

    def emit(self, event, **values):
        try:
            if self.rows >= 1200:
                self.limited = True
                self.invalid('retention_cap', '1200 selected rows exceeded')
                return
            row = dict(kind='E3_same_UID_single_actor_process_delay_join_v10', event=event,
                       keys=self.snapshot(self.keys()), values=self.snapshot(values))
            raw = (json.dumps(row, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
            if self.byte_count + len(raw) > 16 * 1024**2:
                self.limited = True
                self.invalid('retention_cap', '16MiB typed selected JSONL cap exceeded')
                return
            assert self.stream is not None and not self.stream.closed
            assert self.stream.write(raw) == len(raw)
            self.digest.update(raw)
            self.byte_count += len(raw)
            self.rows += 1
            self.counts[event] += 1
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('tap:' + event, traceback.format_exc())

    def bind_runtime_methods(self):
        assert self.proof['passed'] and self.proof['no_historical_source_substitution']
        self.base = next(c for c in type(self.terms['legs']).__mro__ if c.__name__ == 'JointAction')
        assert self.base in type(self.terms['wheels']).__mro__
        for group, cls, method in [('joint', self.base, 'process_actions'), ('wrapper', type(self.vec), 'step')]:
            fn = getattr(cls, method)
            p = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(fn)).resolve()
            expected = self.proof['actual_installed_method_files'][group]
            raw = p.read_bytes()
            assert str(p) == expected['path'] and len(raw) == expected['bytes'] and sha(raw) == expected['SHA']
            src = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(fn)))
            n = next(n for n in src.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef))
            row = next(r for r in expected['methods'] if r['class_name'] == cls.__name__ and r['method'] == method)
            assert method_ast_hash(n) == row['AST_SHA']
        self.metadata_bound = True

    def replace(self, obj, name, value):
        old = getattr(obj, name)
        self.undo.append((obj, name, old))
        setattr(obj, name, value)
        return old

    def original(self, label, call, args, kwargs):
        try:
            return call(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('original_exception:' + label, traceback.format_exc())
            raise

    def actor_return(self, control_index, action):
        try:
            self.control = int(control_index) + 1
            self.issue_tick = int(self.e._sim_step_counter)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('actor_context', traceback.format_exc())
        self.emit('ORIGINAL_SINGLE_ACTOR_RETURN', action=action)

    def install(self):
        join = self
        original_vec = self.vec.step
        def vec_step(this, *args, **kwargs):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_WRAPPER_STEP_INPUT_BEFORE_CLIP', action=args[0] if args else kwargs['actions'])
            return join.original('vec.step', original_vec, args, kwargs)
        self.replace(self.vec, 'step', types.MethodType(vec_step, self.vec))
        original_real = self.e.step
        def real_step(this, *args, **kwargs):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_REAL_STEP_INPUT_AFTER_WRAPPER_CLIP', action=args[0] if args else kwargs['action'])
            return join.original('real.step', original_real, args, kwargs)
        self.replace(self.e, 'step', types.MethodType(real_step, self.e))
        original_affine = self.base.process_actions
        def affine(this, *args, **kwargs):
            result = join.original('SDK.JointAction.process_actions', original_affine, (this,) + args, kwargs)
            if id(this) in join.term_ids:
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_AFFINE_OPTIONAL_CLIP_OUTPUT_BEFORE_CAD', group=join.term_ids[id(this)],
                          raw_actions=this.raw_actions, processed_actions=this.processed_actions)
            return result
        self.replace(self.base, 'process_actions', affine)
        for key, term in self.terms.items():
            old = term.process_actions
            def process(this, *args, _key=key, _old=old, **kwargs):
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_INPUT', group=_key, action=args[0] if args else kwargs['actions'])
                result = join.original('term.process:' + _key, _old, args, kwargs)
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_OUTPUT_AFTER_CAD_AND_SUBMIT', group=_key,
                          raw_actions=this.raw_actions, processed_actions=this.processed_actions)
                return result
            self.replace(term, 'process_actions', types.MethodType(process, term))
        queue = self.e._physics_action_delay.queue
        original_submit = queue.submit
        def submit(key, x, tick):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_INPUT_AFTER_CAD', group=key, issue_tick=int(tick), target=x)
            result = join.original('queue.submit:' + key, original_submit, (key, x, tick), {})
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_SCHEDULE', group=key, original_queue_state=queue.groups[key])
            return result
        self.replace(queue, 'submit', submit)
        original_apply = queue.apply
        def apply(key, tick):
            result = join.original('queue.apply:' + key, original_apply, (key, tick), {})
            if int(tick) < 40:
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_APPLY_RETURN', group=key, apply_tick=int(tick), target=result,
                          original_queue_state=queue.groups[key])
            return result
        self.replace(queue, 'apply', apply)
        original_safe = self.q.safe
        def retained_query(event, **values):
            result = join.original('existing_query.safe', original_safe, (event,), values)
            if event == 'AFTER_ORIGINAL_PHYSICS_SCENE_UPDATE':
                join.emit('EXISTING_CALLBACK_PD_TARGET_AND_DOF_READBACK', existing_values=values,
                          no_added_body_DOF_limit_or_closure_query=True)
            return result
        self.replace(self.q, 'safe', retained_query)
        self.installed = True

    def uninstall(self):
        for obj, name, old in reversed(self.undo):
            try:
                setattr(obj, name, old)
            except BaseException:
                self.invalid('restore_original_attribute:' + name, traceback.format_exc())
        self.undo = []

    def finish(self):
        self.uninstall()
        try:
            if self.stream is not None:
                self.stream.flush()
                self.stream.close()
            self.closed = True
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('close_stream', traceback.format_exc())
        expected = {'ORIGINAL_SINGLE_ACTOR_RETURN': 24, 'ORIGINAL_WRAPPER_STEP_INPUT_BEFORE_CLIP': 24,
                    'ORIGINAL_REAL_STEP_INPUT_AFTER_WRAPPER_CLIP': 24,
                    'ORIGINAL_AFFINE_OPTIONAL_CLIP_OUTPUT_BEFORE_CAD': 48,
                    'ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_INPUT': 48, 'ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_OUTPUT_AFTER_CAD_AND_SUBMIT': 48,
                    'ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_INPUT_AFTER_CAD': 48, 'ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_SCHEDULE': 48,
                    'ORIGINAL_DELAY_APPLY_RETURN': 80, 'EXISTING_CALLBACK_PD_TARGET_AND_DOF_READBACK': 40}
        try:
            if any(self.counts[k] != n for k, n in expected.items()):
                self.invalid('coverage', 'Actual tap counts differ from original24 controls / both40callbacks: ' + str(dict(self.counts)))
            path = self.out / STREAM
            size = path.stat().st_size
            complete = self.closed and size == self.byte_count
            if not complete:
                self.invalid('stream_integrity', 'producer byte count/closed state mismatch')
            value = dict(kind='E3_single_actor_process_delay_same_UID_join_v10',
                diagnostic_valid=self.installed and self.metadata_bound and not self.errors and not self.limited and complete,
                status='INVALID' if self.errors or self.limited or not complete else 'COMPLETE_RETAINED_JOIN_ONLY',
                errors=self.errors, retention_limited=self.limited, actual_counts=dict(self.counts), required_counts=expected,
                actual_installed_method_bytes_AST_bound=self.metadata_bound,
                producer=dict(path=str(path), relative='action_join/' + STREAM, bytes=size,
                    SHA=self.digest.hexdigest() if complete else None, rows=self.rows,
                    type='selected_same_UID_episode_issue_callback_typed_JSONL', full_file_closed=complete,
                    SHA_is_streaming_producer_not_extra_file_read=True, default_transfer='metadata_only'),
                schema_domain=dict(num_envs=20000, selected_IDs=26, recipes=13, controls=24,
                    original_simulation_seconds=.48, physics_ticks_retained=40,
                    complete_request_through_callback_join_first_controls=5,
                    later_controls_request_process_submit_only_not_complete_applied_join=True,
                    callback_alignment='queue apply_tick0..39 occurs before sim.step; corresponding existing scene.update SDK counter1..40; both explicit, no extra callback',
                    identity=['env_id', 'sensor_episode', 'original_recipe', 'control_seq', 'original_issue_physics_tick', 'queue_episode_by_group'],
                    applied_identity='group + queue episode + applied_issue_tick; reset neutral holds are explicit, not fabricated actor instances'),
                no_new_actor_getter_RNG_physics_target_write_or_clamp=True,
                original_results_and_original_exceptions_passed_through_exactly_once=True,
                old_physical24_and_new_join_validity_are_separate=True,
                skill_graduation=False, complete_WM_dataset=False)
            with (self.out / JOIN_PROOF).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            return value
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('publication', traceback.format_exc())
            return dict(diagnostic_valid=False, status='INVALID', errors=self.errors,
                        no_new_actor_getter_RNG_physics_target_write_or_clamp=True)


class InvalidJoin:
    def __init__(self, out, error):
        self.out = Path(out)
        self.error = error
    def actor_return(self, control_index, action):
        return None
    def finish(self):
        value = dict(kind='E3_single_actor_process_delay_same_UID_join_v10', diagnostic_valid=False,
            status='INVALID', errors=[dict(where='constructor_before_hook_installation', error=self.error)],
            original_methods_not_called_retried_or_modified=True, physical24_must_be_read_separately=True,
            producer=None, skill_graduation=False, complete_WM_dataset=False)
        try:
            self.out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            with (self.out / JOIN_PROOF).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        except BaseException:
            value['publication_error'] = traceback.format_exc()
        return value


def install_join(e, vec, observer, torch, out, proof):
    # Even pre-install diagnostic constructor failures do not alter the original
    # actor/step path. A failed tap never retries any original function.
    try:
        return SingleActorActionJoin(e, vec, observer, torch, out, proof)
    except BaseException:
        return InvalidJoin(out, traceback.format_exc())

 def clone(v):
  if torch.is_tensor(v):return v.detach().clone()
  if isinstance(v,dict):return {k:clone(x) for k,x in v.items()}

class JointAction:
 def process_actions(self, actions):
  self._raw_actions[:] = actions
  self._processed_actions = self._raw_actions * self._scale + self._offset
  if self.cfg.clip is not None:
   self._processed_actions = torch.clamp(self._processed_actions, min=self._clip[:,:,0], max=self._clip[:,:,1])
class JointPositionAction(JointAction):
 def __init__(self, cfg, env):
  self._offset = self._asset.data.default_joint_pos
 def apply_actions(self):
  self._asset.set_joint_position_target_index(target=self.processed_actions, joint_ids=self._joint_ids)
class JointVelocityAction(JointAction):
 def apply_actions(self):
  self._asset.set_joint_velocity_target_index(target=self.processed_actions, joint_ids=self._joint_ids)

class JointAction:
 def process_actions(self, actions):
  self._raw_actions[:] = actions
  self._processed_actions = self._raw_actions * self._scale + self._offset
  if self.cfg.clip is not None:
   self._processed_actions = torch.clamp(self._processed_actions, min=self._clip[:,:,0], max=self._clip[:,:,1])
class JointPositionAction(JointAction):
 def __init__(self, cfg, env):
  self._offset = self._asset.data.default_joint_pos
 def apply_actions(self):
  self._asset.set_joint_position_target_index(target=self.processed_actions, joint_ids=self._joint_ids)
class JointVelocityAction(JointAction):
 def apply_actions(self):
  self._asset.set_joint_velocity_target_index(target=self.processed_actions, joint_ids=self._joint_ids)

class JointAction:
 def process_actions(self, actions):
  self._raw_actions[:] = actions
  self._processed_actions = self._raw_actions * self._scale + self._offset
  if self.cfg.clip is not None:
   self._processed_actions = torch.clamp(self._processed_actions, min=self._clip[:,:,0], max=self._clip[:,:,1])
class JointPositionAction(JointAction):
 def __init__(self, cfg, env):
  self._offset = self._asset.data.default_joint_pos
 def apply_actions(self):
  self._asset.set_joint_position_target_index(target=self.processed_actions, joint_ids=self._joint_ids)

class JointAction:
 def process_actions(self, actions):
  self._raw_actions[:] = actions
  self._processed_actions = self._raw_actions * self._scale + self._offset
  if self.cfg.clip is not None:
   self._processed_actions = torch.clamp(self._processed_actions, min=self._clip[:,:,0], max=self._clip[:,:,1])
class JointPositionAction(JointAction):
 def __init__(self, cfg, env):
  self._offset = self._asset.data.default_joint_pos
 def apply_actions(self):
  self._asset.set_joint_position_target_index(target=self.processed_actions, joint_ids=self._joint_ids)
class JointVelocityAction(JointAction):

  self._asset.set_joint_velocity_target_index(target=self.processed_actions, joint_ids=self._joint_ids)

from collections.abc import Mapping

METHOD_PROOF = 'E3_ACTUAL_INSTALLED_ACTION_METHOD_AST_BYTES_METADATA.json'
JOIN_PROOF = 'E3_SINGLE_ACTOR_PROCESS_DELAY_SAME_UID_JOIN_ACTUAL.json'
STREAM = 'E3_single_actor_process_delay_same_UID_selected.jsonl'
METHODS = {
    'joint': [('JointAction', 'process_actions'), ('JointPositionAction', '__init__'),
              ('JointPositionAction', 'apply_actions'), ('JointVelocityAction', 'apply_actions')],
    'wrapper': [('RslRlVecEnvWrapper', 'step')],
}


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def method_node(tree, cls, name):
    c = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == cls)
    return next(n for n in c.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name)


def method_ast_hash(n):
    return sha(ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False).encode('utf-8'))


def inspect_installed_method_files(joint_file, wrapper_file):
    """Parse genuinely selected installation files in future0PT target admission.

    No import/execution of these SDK modules is performed by this function.
    Paths are supplied from actual find_spec roots, not historical fixture paths.
    """
    result = {}
    for group, path in [('joint', Path(joint_file)), ('wrapper', Path(wrapper_file))]:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        tree = ast.parse(raw)
        rows = []
        for cls, name in METHODS[group]:
            fn = method_node(tree, cls, name)
            rows.append(dict(class_name=cls, method=name, AST_SHA=method_ast_hash(fn),
                             line=fn.lineno, end_line=fn.end_lineno,
                             exact_source=ast.get_source_segment(raw.decode('utf-8'), fn)))
        result[group] = dict(path=str(path.resolve()), bytes=len(raw), SHA=sha(raw), methods=rows)
    joint_tree = ast.parse(Path(joint_file).read_bytes())
    base = method_node(joint_tree, 'JointAction', 'process_actions')
    # Source-specific diagnostic admission; retain the actual entire method hash.
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and ast.unparse(n) ==
               'self._processed_actions = self._raw_actions * self._scale + self._offset'
               for n in base.body), 'Actual affine source differs; no historical API assumption'
    position = method_node(joint_tree, 'JointPositionAction', 'apply_actions')
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute)
               and n.func.attr == 'set_joint_position_target_index' for n in ast.walk(position))
    wrapper = method_node(ast.parse(Path(wrapper_file).read_bytes()), 'RslRlVecEnvWrapper', 'step')
    env_calls = [n for n in ast.walk(wrapper) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'self.env.step']
    assert len(env_calls) == 1
    assert any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func) == 'torch.clamp' for n in ast.walk(wrapper))
    return dict(passed=True, scope='Actual installation source bytes/AST only; NOT App/model/CUDA proof',
                actual_installed_method_files=result, no_historical_source_substitution=True,
                no_SDK_module_execution_or_PT_NPZ_GPU_RNG=True)


def collect_actual_target_method_metadata(job):
    lab = Path(importlib.util.find_spec('isaaclab').origin).resolve().parent
    rl = Path(importlib.util.find_spec('isaaclab_rl').origin).resolve().parent
    value = inspect_installed_method_files(lab / 'envs/mdp/actions/joint_actions.py',
                                           rl / 'rsl_rl/vecenv_wrapper.py')
    value['actual_package_roots'] = dict(isaaclab=str(lab), isaaclab_rl=str(rl))
    with (Path(job) / METHOD_PROOF).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    return value


class SingleActorActionJoin:
    def __init__(self, e, vec, query_observer, torch, out, method_proof):
        self.e = e
        self.vec = vec
        self.q = query_observer
        self.t = torch
        self.out = Path(out)
        self.ids = query_observer.ids.detach().clone()
        self.errors = []
        self.counts = Counter()
        self.undo = []
        self.control = None
        self.issue_tick = None
        self.byte_count = 0
        self.rows = 0
        self.digest = hashlib.sha256()
        self.stream = None
        self.limited = False
        self.installed = False
        self.closed = False
        self.metadata_bound = False
        self.term_ids = {}
        self.terms = {}
        self.proof = method_proof
        try:
            self.out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
            self.stream = (self.out / STREAM).open('xb')
            assert e.num_envs == 20000 and e.physics_dt == .0025 and e.step_dt == .02
            assert len(self.ids) == 26 and query_observer.full30_limits is not None
            self.terms = {key: e.action_manager.get_term(key) for key in ('legs', 'wheels')}
            self.term_ids = {id(v): k for k, v in self.terms.items()}
            self.bind_runtime_methods()
            self.install()
            self.emit('ACTUAL_CACHED_TERM_CONFIGURATION_AND_ORIGINAL_LIMITS',
                term_configuration={k: dict(joint_ids=term._joint_ids, joint_names=term._joint_names,
                    scale=term._scale, offset=term._offset, cfg_clip=term.cfg.clip,
                    optional_clip_buffer=getattr(term, '_clip', None)) for k, term in self.terms.items()},
                actual_joint_names=list(e.scene['robot'].joint_names),
                existing_full30_limits=query_observer.full30_limits,
                existing_default_joint_pos=self.cached(e.scene['robot'].data.default_joint_pos),
                selected_only_26_IDs=True, no_added_original_getter=True)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('constructor_or_actual_runtime_method_binding', traceback.format_exc())
            self.uninstall()

    def cached(self, value):
        return value.torch if hasattr(value, 'torch') else value

    def invalid(self, where, error):
        if len(self.errors) < 32:
            self.errors.append(dict(where=where, error=error))

    def snapshot(self, value):
        t = self.t
        value = self.cached(value)
        if t.is_tensor(value):
            original_shape = list(value.shape)
            per_env = value.ndim > 0 and value.shape[0] == self.e.num_envs
            v = value.index_select(0, self.ids.to(device=value.device, dtype=t.long)) if per_env else value
            v = v.detach().cpu()
            row = dict(dtype=str(v.dtype), original_device=str(value.device), shape=list(v.shape),
                       original_shape=original_shape, axis0_is_selected_env=per_env)
            if v.is_floating_point() and not bool(t.isfinite(v).all()):
                finite = t.isfinite(v)
                if bool(t.isnan(v).any()):
                    self.invalid('NaN_diagnostic_value', 'NaN retained with explicit code2; original value/result not changed')
                codes = t.where(t.isposinf(v), t.ones_like(v, dtype=t.int8),
                        t.where(t.isneginf(v), -t.ones_like(v, dtype=t.int8),
                        t.where(t.isnan(v), t.full_like(v, 2, dtype=t.int8), t.zeros_like(v, dtype=t.int8))))
                row.update(finite_value_or_zero=t.where(finite, v, t.zeros_like(v)).tolist(), nonfinite_code=codes.tolist(),
                           nonfinite_code_semantics={'0': 'finite value', '1': '+infinity', '-1': '-infinity', '2': 'NaN; diagnostic domain invalid'})
            else:
                row['value'] = v.tolist()
            return row
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            if all(isinstance(k, str) for k in value):
                return {k: self.snapshot(v) for k, v in value.items()}
            return dict(container_type='typed_key_mapping', entries=[dict(key=encode_snapshot_mapping_key(k),
                          value=self.snapshot(v)) for k, v in value.items()])
        if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
            return [self.snapshot(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, slice):
            return dict(container_type='slice', start=value.start, stop=value.stop, step=value.step)
        if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
            return dict(scalar_type='float', nonfinite='+infinity' if value > 0 else '-infinity' if value < 0 else 'NaN')
        if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, bool, int, float)):
            return value
        raise TypeError('Unsupported typed join value: ' + type(value).__name__)

    def keys(self):
        return dict(env_id=self.ids, sensor_episode=self.e._sensor_mild.episode,
                    original_recipe=self.e.recovery.recipe, control_seq=self.control,
                    original_issue_physics_tick=self.issue_tick, callback_tick=int(self.e._sim_step_counter),
                    queue_episode_by_group={k: self.e._physics_action_delay.queue.groups[k]['episode'] for k in self.terms})

    def emit(self, event, **values):
        try:
            if self.rows >= 1200:
                self.limited = True
                self.invalid('retention_cap', '1200 selected rows exceeded')
                return
            row = dict(kind='E3_same_UID_single_actor_process_delay_join_v10', event=event,
                       keys=self.snapshot(self.keys()), values=self.snapshot(values))
            raw = (json.dumps(row, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
            if self.byte_count + len(raw) > 16 * 1024**2:
                self.limited = True
                self.invalid('retention_cap', '16MiB typed selected JSONL cap exceeded')
                return
            assert self.stream is not None and not self.stream.closed
            assert self.stream.write(raw) == len(raw)
            self.digest.update(raw)
            self.byte_count += len(raw)
            self.rows += 1
            self.counts[event] += 1
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('tap:' + event, traceback.format_exc())

    def bind_runtime_methods(self):
        assert self.proof['passed'] and self.proof['no_historical_source_substitution']
        self.base = next(c for c in type(self.terms['legs']).__mro__ if c.__name__ == 'JointAction')
        assert self.base in type(self.terms['wheels']).__mro__
        for group, cls, method in [('joint', self.base, 'process_actions'), ('wrapper', type(self.vec), 'step')]:
            fn = getattr(cls, method)
            p = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(fn)).resolve()
            expected = self.proof['actual_installed_method_files'][group]
            raw = p.read_bytes()
            assert str(p) == expected['path'] and len(raw) == expected['bytes'] and sha(raw) == expected['SHA']
            src = ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(fn)))
            n = next(n for n in src.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef))
            row = next(r for r in expected['methods'] if r['class_name'] == cls.__name__ and r['method'] == method)
            assert method_ast_hash(n) == row['AST_SHA']
        self.metadata_bound = True

    def replace(self, obj, name, value):
        old = getattr(obj, name)
        self.undo.append((obj, name, old))
        setattr(obj, name, value)
        return old

    def original(self, label, call, args, kwargs):
        try:
            return call(*args, **kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('original_exception:' + label, traceback.format_exc())
            raise

    def actor_return(self, control_index, action):
        try:
            self.control = int(control_index) + 1
            self.issue_tick = int(self.e._sim_step_counter)
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('actor_context', traceback.format_exc())
        self.emit('ORIGINAL_SINGLE_ACTOR_RETURN', action=action)

    def install(self):
        join = self
        original_vec = self.vec.step
        def vec_step(this, *args, **kwargs):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_WRAPPER_STEP_INPUT_BEFORE_CLIP', action=args[0] if args else kwargs['actions'])
            return join.original('vec.step', original_vec, args, kwargs)
        self.replace(self.vec, 'step', types.MethodType(vec_step, self.vec))
        original_real = self.e.step
        def real_step(this, *args, **kwargs):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_REAL_STEP_INPUT_AFTER_WRAPPER_CLIP', action=args[0] if args else kwargs['action'])
            return join.original('real.step', original_real, args, kwargs)
        self.replace(self.e, 'step', types.MethodType(real_step, self.e))
        original_affine = self.base.process_actions
        def affine(this, *args, **kwargs):
            result = join.original('SDK.JointAction.process_actions', original_affine, (this,) + args, kwargs)
            if id(this) in join.term_ids:
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_AFFINE_OPTIONAL_CLIP_OUTPUT_BEFORE_CAD', group=join.term_ids[id(this)],
                          raw_actions=this.raw_actions, processed_actions=this.processed_actions)
            return result
        self.replace(self.base, 'process_actions', affine)
        for key, term in self.terms.items():
            old = term.process_actions
            def process(this, *args, _key=key, _old=old, **kwargs):
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_INPUT', group=_key, action=args[0] if args else kwargs['actions'])
                result = join.original('term.process:' + _key, _old, args, kwargs)
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_OUTPUT_AFTER_CAD_AND_SUBMIT', group=_key,
                          raw_actions=this.raw_actions, processed_actions=this.processed_actions)
                return result
            self.replace(term, 'process_actions', types.MethodType(process, term))
        queue = self.e._physics_action_delay.queue
        original_submit = queue.submit
        def submit(key, x, tick):
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_INPUT_AFTER_CAD', group=key, issue_tick=int(tick), target=x)
            result = join.original('queue.submit:' + key, original_submit, (key, x, tick), {})
            join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_SCHEDULE', group=key, original_queue_state=queue.groups[key])
            return result
        self.replace(queue, 'submit', submit)
        original_apply = queue.apply
        def apply(key, tick):
            result = join.original('queue.apply:' + key, original_apply, (key, tick), {})
            if int(tick) < 40:
                join.emit('ORIGINAL_DELAY_APPLY_RETURN', group=key, apply_tick=int(tick), target=result,
                          original_queue_state=queue.groups[key])
            return result
        self.replace(queue, 'apply', apply)
        original_safe = self.q.safe
        def retained_query(event, **values):
            result = join.original('existing_query.safe', original_safe, (event,), values)
            if event == 'AFTER_ORIGINAL_PHYSICS_SCENE_UPDATE':
                join.emit('EXISTING_CALLBACK_PD_TARGET_AND_DOF_READBACK', existing_values=values,
                          no_added_body_DOF_limit_or_closure_query=True)
            return result
        self.replace(self.q, 'safe', retained_query)
        self.installed = True

    def uninstall(self):
        for obj, name, old in reversed(self.undo):
            try:
                setattr(obj, name, old)
            except BaseException:
                self.invalid('restore_original_attribute:' + name, traceback.format_exc())
        self.undo = []

    def finish(self):
        self.uninstall()
        try:
            if self.stream is not None:
                self.stream.flush()
                self.stream.close()
            self.closed = True
        except BaseException:
            self.invalid('close_stream', traceback.format_exc())
        expected = {'ORIGINAL_SINGLE_ACTOR_RETURN': 24, 'ORIGINAL_WRAPPER_STEP_INPUT_BEFORE_CLIP': 24,
                    'ORIGINAL_REAL_STEP_INPUT_AFTER_WRAPPER_CLIP': 24,
                    'ORIGINAL_AFFINE_OPTIONAL_CLIP_OUTPUT_BEFORE_CAD': 48,
                    'ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_INPUT': 48, 'ORIGINAL_TERM_PROCESS_OUTPUT_AFTER_CAD_AND_SUBMIT': 48,
                    'ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_INPUT_AFTER_CAD': 48, 'ORIGINAL_DELAY_SUBMIT_SCHEDULE': 48,
                    'ORIGINAL_DELAY_APPLY_RETURN': 80, 'EXISTING_CALLBACK_PD_TARGET_AND_DOF_READBACK': 40}
        try:
            if any(self.counts[k] != n for k, n in expected.items()):
                self.invalid('coverage', 'Actual tap counts differ from original24 controls / both40callbacks: ' + str(dict(self.counts)))
            path = self.out / STREAM
            size = path.stat().st_size
            complete = self.closed and size == self.byte_count
            if not complete:
                self.invalid('stream_integrity', 'producer byte count/closed state mismatch')
            value = dict(kind='E3_single_actor_process_delay_same_UID_join_v10',
                diagnostic_valid=self.installed and self.metadata_bound and not self.errors and not self.limited and complete,
                status='INVALID' if self.errors or self.limited or not complete else 'COMPLETE_RETAINED_JOIN_ONLY',
                errors=self.errors, retention_limited=self.limited, actual_counts=dict(self.counts), required_counts=expected,
                actual_installed_method_bytes_AST_bound=self.metadata_bound,
                producer=dict(path=str(path), relative='action_join/' + STREAM, bytes=size,
                    SHA=self.digest.hexdigest() if complete else None, rows=self.rows,
                    type='selected_same_UID_episode_issue_callback_typed_JSONL', full_file_closed=complete,
                    SHA_is_streaming_producer_not_extra_file_read=True, default_transfer='metadata_only'),
